# Uptimyzas Kitchen
Good food, served fast. Right here in Ondo.

## About
Uptimyzas Kitchen serves hot Nigerian meals at fair prices. Open 6am to 10pm, every day including Sundays. Located beside Eric photoshop, opposite Adeyemi Federal University, Ondo.
